newsitem.title: USA: Duke sees Oconee 2 unit back by mid-week.
newsitem.headline: Duke sees Oconee 2 unit back by mid-week.

text.p: Duke Power Co said it expected its 846 megawatt (MW) Oconee 2 nuclear power unit in Seneca, S.C., to return on line by midweek after it was manually shut to repair a valve.
"It may be up earlier, but it should on line mid-week," said company spokesman Rick Zuercher.
The Nuclear Regulatory Commission reported earlier Monday that the unit was likely to resume service later today.
The adjacent Oconee units 1 and 3, also each rated at 846 MW, are producing power at full output, he said.
Duke is the operator and sole owner of the Oconee units.
